content.text:
<user_query>
Explore the AXEL Godot project in readonly mode and identify where the combat HUD layout is defined for: history bar title/text, items text, top-right goal and numeric value, seed and icons alignment, stake indicator (plus/minus and value/circle). Focus on scene files and report exact node paths/properties likely controlling font sizes/anchors/margins/alignment. Return concise bullet list with file paths and node names/properties only.
</user_query>

Searching combat HUD scenes and related UI nodes for layout properties.

[REDACTED]

input.final_summary: Combat HUD layout lives primarily in `combat_test.tscn` (canonical F6 scene). Below are exact node paths and the scene/theme properties controlling fonts, anchors, margins, and alignment for each requested HUD region.

content.text:
**Primary scene:** `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\combat_test.tscn`  
**Root theme (inherited defaults):** `c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\ui\terminal_theme.tres` → `CombatTest2.theme`

---

### History bar (title + list area)
- **`PlayArea/PlayRow/HistoryPanel`** — `custom_minimum_size`, `size_flags_horizontal=0`, `size_flags_vertical=0`, `theme_override_styles/panel` → `StyleBoxFlat_avfyl` (`content_margin_*`=8)
- **`PlayArea/PlayRow/HistoryPanel/@VBoxContainer@21363`** — `theme_override_constants/separation`=4
- **`.../@PanelContainer@21364`** — `theme_override_styles/panel` → `StyleBoxFlat_xug1b` (`content_margin_left/right`=8, `content_margin_top/bottom`=6)
- **`.../SectionHeader`** — `theme_override_font_sizes/font_size`=24, `theme_override_colors/font_color`, `horizontal_alignment`=1, `text`="HISTORY"
- **`.../@ScrollContainer@21367`** — `size_flags_vertical`=3, `horizontal_scroll_mode`=0
- **`.../HistorySpinList`** — `theme_override_constants/separation`=4  
  *(History row body text is not in the scene; rows are added at runtime under `HistorySpinList`.)*

---

### Items panel (title + item text)
- **`PlayArea/PlayRow/ItemPickerPanel`** — `custom_minimum_size`, `size_flags_horizontal=0`, `size_flags_vertical=0`, `theme_override_styles/panel` → `StyleBoxFlat_toamn` (`content_margin_*`=8)
- **`.../@VBoxContainer@21369`** — `theme_override_constants/separation`=4
- **`.../@PanelContainer@21370`** — `theme_override_styles/panel` → `StyleBoxFlat_3wx3o` (`content_margin_left/right`=8, `content_margin_top/bottom`=6)
- **`.../SectionHeader`** — `theme_override_font_sizes/font_size`=24, `theme_override_colors/font_color`, `horizontal_alignment`=1, `text`="ITEMS (0/7)"
- **`.../@ScrollContainer@21373/@VBoxContainer@21374`** — `theme_override_constants/separation`=4
- **`.../@CheckBox@21375` / `@CheckBox@21376`** (item rows) — `theme_override_font_sizes/font_size`=16, `theme_override_colors/font_color`

---

### Top-right goal + numeric value
- **`GoalBox`** (root child) — `anchor_left`=0.86, `anchor_top`=0.025, `anchor_right`=0.992, `anchor_bottom`=0.135, `grow_horizontal`=2, `grow_vertical`=2, `theme_override_styles/panel` → `StyleBoxEmpty_avfyl`
- **`GoalBox/GoalLabel`** — `size_flags_horizontal`=3, `theme_override_font_sizes/font_size`=36, `horizontal_alignment`=2, `vertical_alignment`=1, `text`="GOAL\n0 / 0" *(title + numeric on one label)*

---

### Seed + icons alignment (top-left)
- **`MetaBox`** — `anchor_left`=0.008, `anchor_top`=0.025, `anchor_right`=0.14, `anchor_bottom`=0.135, `grow_horizontal`=2, `grow_vertical`=2, `theme_override_styles/panel` → `StyleBoxEmpty_avfyl`
- **`MetaBox/MetaContent`** — `theme_override_constants/separation`=4
- **`MetaBox/MetaContent/MetaIconsRow`** — `theme_override_constants/separation`=4
- **`.../GearIcon` / `HomeIcon` / `ThirdIcon`** — `size_flags_horizontal`=4, `theme_override_font_sizes/font_size`=31, `horizontal_alignment`=1
- **`MetaBox/MetaContent/SeedRow`** — `theme_override_constants/separation`=4
- **`.../SeedLabel`** — no scene font override *(inherits `terminal_theme.tres` → `Label/font_sizes/font_size`=34)*
- **`.../SeedSpinBox`** — `size_flags_horizontal`=3 *(inherits `terminal_theme.tres` → `SpinBox/font_sizes/font_size`=32)*

---

### Stake indicator (− / value pill / +)
- **`EconomicsCenter`** — `anchor_left`=0.36, `anchor_top`=0.03, `anchor_right`=0.64, `anchor_bottom`=0.14, `grow_horizontal`=2, `grow_vertical`=2
- **`EconomicsCenter/@VBoxContainer@20632`** — `theme_override_constants/separation`=4, `alignment`=1
- **`.../StakeSelector`** — `size_flags_horizontal`=4, `size_flags_vertical`=4, `theme_override_constants/separation`=12, `alignment`=1
- **`.../StakeSelector/BetRow`** — `theme_override_constants/separation`=12, `alignment`=1
- **`.../BetMinusButton`** — `custom_minimum_size`=Vector2(40, 40), `text`="-" *(inherits `Button/font_sizes/font_size`=36 from theme)*
- **`.../StakePill`** — `theme_override_styles/panel` → `StyleBoxFlat_nwpd3` (`content_margin_left/right`=16, `content_margin_top/bottom`=4, `corner_radius_*`=18)
- **`.../StakePill/BetLabel`** — `theme_override_font_sizes/font_size`=22, `horizontal_alignment`=1, `text`="100"
- **`.../BetPlusButton`** — `custom_minimum_size`=Vector2(40, 40), `text`="+" *(inherits theme Button font size 36)*

---

### Secondary / unused for live HUD
- **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\combat_test_scaffold_baseline.tscn`** — fallback scaffold; same node names but under `TopBar/` with offset-based `GoalBox` anchors and no `StakePill` wrapper
- **`c:\Users\valtt\OneDrive\Godot\AXEL\axel_project\combat\scenes\goal_hud.tscn`** — minimal standalone `GoalHUD/GoalLabel`; not the main combat HUD
